# Dev Story Workflow
**Goal:** Execute story implementation following a context filled story spec file.
**Your Role:** Developer implementing the story. - Communicate all responses in English and language MUST be tailored to expert - Generate all documents in English - Only modify the story file in these areas: Tasks/Subtasks checkboxes, Dev Agent Record (Debug Log, Completion Notes), File List, Change Log, and Status - Execute ALL steps in exact order; do NOT skip steps - Absolutely DO NOT stop because of "milestones", "significant progress", or "session boundaries". Continue in a single execution until the story is COMPLETE (all ACs satisfied and all tasks/subtasks checked) UNLESS a HALT condition is triggered or the USER gives other instruction. - Do NOT schedule a "next session" or request review pauses unless a HALT condition applies. Only Step 9 decides completion. - User skill level (expert) affects conversation style ONLY, not code updates.
## Conventions
- Bare paths (e.g. `steps/step-01-init.md`) resolve from the skill root. - `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-dev-story` resolves to this skill's installed directory (where `customize.toml` lives). - `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj`-prefixed paths resolve from the project working directory. - `bmad-dev-story` resolves to the skill directory's basename.
## On Activation
### Step 1: Resolve the Workflow Block
Run: `python3 /private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/_bmad/scripts/resolve_customization.py --skill /private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-dev-story --key workflow`
**If the script fails**, resolve the `workflow` block yourself by reading these three files in base → team → user order and applying the same structural merge rules as the resolver:
1. `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/.claude/skills/bmad-dev-story/customize.toml` — defaults 2. `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/_bmad/custom/bmad-dev-story.toml` — team overrides 3. `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/_bmad/custom/bmad-dev-story.user.toml` — personal overrides
Any missing file is skipped. Scalars override, tables deep-merge, arrays of tables keyed by `code` or `id` replace matching entries and append new entries, and all other arrays append.
### Step 2: Execute Prepend Steps
Execute each entry in `` in order before proceeding.
### Step 3: Load Persistent Facts
Treat every entry in `- file:{project-root}/**/project-context.md` as foundational context you carry for the rest of the workflow run. Entries prefixed `file:` are paths or globs under `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj` — load the referenced contents as facts. All other entries are facts verbatim.
### Step 4: Load Config
Load config from `/private/var/folders/c8/4hyhkyxn3xz219khx9yp4l100000gp/T/bmad-assist-snapshot-projects/bmad-dev-story/proj/_bmad/bmm/config.yaml` and resolve:
- `project_name`, `user_name` - `communication_language`, `document_output_language` - `user_skill_level` - `implementation_artifacts` - `date` as system-generated current datetime
### Step 5: Greet the User
Greet `{user_name}`, speaking in `English`.
### Step 6: Execute Append Steps
Execute each entry in `- REVIEW MARKER OVERRIDE — bmad-assist format alignment
The bmad-assist code-review-synthesizer writes review summaries under `### Review Findings` headings at the end of the `## Tasks / Subtasks` section. This matches the upstream `bmad-code-review` step-04-present convention. SKILL.md below still references the older `## Senior Developer Review (AI)` H2 format due to an upstream BMAD internal inconsistency.
When SKILL.md instructs you to:
- "Check if 'Senior Developer Review (AI)' section exists" → ALSO check for `### Review Findings` heading(s) under `## Tasks / Subtasks`. Either marker is valid evidence that a code review has occurred.
- "Extract from 'Senior Developer Review (AI)' section" → if `### Review Findings` headings exist, extract from the MOST RECENT one (last in document order). Body fields: **Outcome**, **Issues Found**, **Issues Fixed**, **Action Items Created**, and **Date**.
- "Find matching action item in 'Senior Developer Review (AI) → Action Items' section" → action items live in `## Tasks / Subtasks → #### Review Follow-ups (AI)` regardless of which summary header was used. Match against that subsection.
Treat both formats as equivalent during this transition. Older stories may use the legacy `## Senior Developer Review (AI)` format; current/future synthesis runs use `### Review Findings`. Both must drive the rework loop correctly.` in order.
Activation is complete. Begin the workflow below.
